name: BubblePhys
description: Physics of bubble-bubble interactions, for use with BubbleMat

attributes.name: surfaceTension
attributes.description: Surface tension of the surrounding liquid

attributes.name: rAvg
attributes.description: Average radius of the two interacting bubbles

attributes.name: Dmax
attributes.description: Maximum penetrationDepth of the bubbles before the force displacement curve changes to an artificial exponential curve. Setting this value will have no effect. See Law2_ScGeom_BubblePhys_Bubble::pctMaxForce for more information

attributes.name: newtonIter
attributes.description: Maximum number of force iterations allowed

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.

methods.name: computeForce
methods.description: Computes the normal force acting between the two interacting bubbles using the Newton-Rhapson method
